name: Vornorexant
summary: Vornorexant, sold under the brand name Vorzzz, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in Japan. It is taken orally.5, 5, and 10 mg oral tablets. It has been found to improve sleep onset, sleep maintenance, and daytime functioning with both short-term and long-term use.

pharmacology.text: Vornorexant, sold under the brand name Vorzzz, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in Japan. Vornorexant acts as a dual orexin OX1 and OX2 receptor antagonist (DORA).
pharmacology.kind: Orexin receptor antagonist; Orexin OX1 and OX2 receptor antagonist; Hypnotic

uses.text: Vornorexant, sold under the brand name Vorzzz, is an orexin receptor antagonist which is used in the treatment of insomnia in Japan. It was developed by Taisho Pharmaceutical in Japan. The drug was approved for the treatment of insomnia in Japan in August 2025.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of vornorexant include somnolence among others.
